cause: The immutable evaluator mounts the parent probes/ directory as the Agda include root. Revision-3 files were placed under probes/rev3/ but retained unqualified module names, so Agda required modules named rev3.<Name> and rejected every file before checking its target.
preserved_evidence: Each probe/first and probe/replay directory retains command, stdout, stderr and result files. All 20 exits were 42 with module-path diagnostics.
disposition: Preserved as a failed path/module qualification attempt. Revision 4 must use fresh top-level probe filenames whose module declarations match exactly.
